g.text: EXP-007: all frozen waveform comparisons at new starting points
Tail: 75<t≤300. Positive contrasts favor hybrid. Tangent/axes select identical actions here.
Intervals are descriptive for selected anchors; no population/multiplicity claim.
H00–H11: holdout-00–11; Tan.=tangent; U16=uniform16; A21=augmented21. Gray/×: undefined; no success-only deletion.
[S] sensitivity; [M] old map. Hybrid uses S for small doses, M for largest. All require baseline; previews shared in collection.
Collection 137.51 s; preview-call sum 161.85 s; 48 sensitivity calls 23.52 s. Concurrent sums ≠ elapsed time.
Old atlas: 140.54 s separately. Preview counts exclude prerequisites. Total compute is not matched; no speedup established.
